OVERREACH: No causal claim; they only describe mean. They mention "no adjustment for confounding was made, as the question did not ask for a causal effect". That's fine. No overreach.

UNACKNOWLEDGED DATA PROBLEMS: Check if any data issues ignored. The data dictionary notes assay_batch unit error but says only affects biomarker_final, not baseline. That's fine. Any other issues? The baseline sentinel -999 removed. Duplicates handled. Any missing values? None indicated. The severity column may have case sensitivity? In data snippet severity 'severe' lower case; they filter 'severe' exactly. Good. No other problems.

FALSE PREMISE: The question didn't assume false premise. They didn't answer a false premise. So fine.

Thus answer is sound. Verdict accept, no issues.
